gen-vast-shadow-gf-noto-sans-warang-citi: Words in Noto Sans Warang Citi settle into solid blocks, with generous channels leading into every counter. Vast Shadow is the loud one here, a vintage display face cut at a single stroke width, and that blueprint-lettering steadiness is what the pair does best.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-noto-sans-yi: Vintage and attention-grabbing up top, Vast Shadow keeps its lines uniform. Noto Sans Yi underneath has a deep lowercase midsection and open, unlatched rounds, so the heading's pinched-free, unswelling strokes meet a body with more bulk and movement.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-noto-sans-zanabazar-s: Noto Sans Zanabazar Square has a soaring x-height and wide gaps that keep tiny sizes crisp, a friendly counterpart to Vast Shadow's unit-width strokes. Paragraphs would feel open and approachable.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-noto-traditional-nush: Vast Shadow looks like glass tubing bent into letters, vintage and hard to ignore with its tall mean line. And Noto Traditional Nushu, with its broad-nibbed strokes and bowls that fill the line, would hold up fine if the heading were made small, though the heading prefers room.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-numans: Numans reads wide and spaced out, its s ends hanging far from the spine. Vast Shadow draws every line at one weight for vintage, eye-catching impact, while the sans-serif body gives swollen, rope-like lowercase for steady reading.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-onest: Onest keeps its ascenders short above big bowls, with a gentle, monotone line and no ink pooling in the turns. Onest is the quiet half, and Vast Shadow's single-width vintage lettering and tall mean line make the strongest impression of the pair.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-orienta: Modern and neutral, Orienta has counters that breathe like a cut reed. Vast Shadow keeps its thickness constant around every curve, so a long passage in the plain sans would feel unhurried beneath a vintage, wire-straight heading.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-oxygen: Contemporary and clean, Oxygen keeps its curves open and its lowercase near the capitals. Vast Shadow, drawn with steady pen pressure from first letter to last, supplies the vintage drama while the sans keeps everything else easy to follow.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-parkinsans: Parkinsans holds one stroke thickness everywhere, with wide-mouthed letters that stay crisp shrunk down. Vast Shadow brings vintage, eye-catching flair with plenty of space around each letter, and next to the sturdy sans-serif lowercase it feels like a showpiece beside a workhorse.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-pathway-extreme: Wire-like and vintage, Vast Shadow grabs attention with a tall mean line. And Pathway Extreme answers with clear openings in rounded letters and stubby ascenders, while the heading earns its keep big and brief.
